note: The verdict each declared model is REQUIRED to produce, per escalation policy.
CI fails on any deviation in either direction: a model that was SAFE turning
UNSAFE is a regression, and a model declared UNSAFE turning SAFE means the
verifier stopped finding a counterexample it is supposed to find.
'unsafe' entries are deliberate: they are how the suite proves the verifier
can still fail. Changing one to 'safe' to make CI green is a defect, not a fix.
SAFE_BUT_NOT_LIVE (2026-11) refines SAFE_WITHIN_MODEL: no unsafe state is
reachable, but a declared legitimate goal is not reachable under governance
either. Those models were safe partly because legitimate work could not happen.
